 Order
These are applications for anticipatory bail.

2. The petitioners in these bail applications are accused Nos.1, 2, 4 and 5 in Crime No.930 of 2023 of Valiathura Police Station, Thiruvananthapuram District, alleging commission of offences under Section 294(b), 323 and 498A read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

The allegation against the petitioners is that after the marriage of the petitioner in Bail Application No.7679 of 2023 with the de-facto complainant, the petitioners misused the gifts given to the de-facto complainant at the time of her marriage.

It is also alleged that certain amounts being sent by the father of the de-facto complainant every month were misused by the accused and that further demands were made for dowry and the de-facto complainant was subjected to mental and physical cruelty.
3. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners would submit that the petitioners are absolutely innocent in the matter.

It is submitted that the allegations are raised only to bolster the case of the de-facto complainant in the matrimonial disputes between the petitioner in Bail Application No.7679 of 2023 and the de-facto complainant.

It is submitted that considering the nature of the BAIL APPL. NOS. 7679 & 7680 OF 2023 allegations, the custodial interrogation of the petitioners Jemma Diction vs State Of Kerala on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73061711/

sentences.text: 4. Heard the learned Public Prosecutor also.

5. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor and having regard the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations raised against the petitioners, I am of the view that the petitioners can be granted anticipatory bail.
No criminal antecedents are reported against any of the petitioners.
Further, the custodial interrogation of the petitioners does not appear to be necessary for a proper investigation into Crime No.930 of 2023 of Valiathura Police Station.
(iv) The petitioners shall not involve in any other crime while on bail.

If any of the aforesaid conditions are violated, the investigating officer in Crime No.930 of 2023 of Valiathura Police Station may file an application before the jurisdictional Court, for cancellation of bail.
